name: Wit of the Shadowscape
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 10 minutes per level

DESCRIPTION

For the duration of the spell, you do not incur the usual -5 penalty to Stealth checks when moving at a speed greater than half but less than your normal speed.
